Two other fenced blocks confirmed legitimate on re-check: lines 18-20 quote the EXISTING/current buggy code verbatim as a citation (SS1 problem statement, describing what's there today), not proposed implementation -- evidence/diagnosis, not a fix to copy-paste; lines 46-48 are the function signature only (marked unchanged), explicitly permitted per the signatures/type-shapes-only convention. Everything else in the document (SS1 problem statement, SS3 hardcode-vs-pattern rationale, SS4 tradeoff discussion, SS5 open questions, SS6 implementation notes, SS7 test cases, SS8 acceptance-criteria mapping, tenant.ex/frontend-requirements.md citations) untouched.
